hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Find clear answers to common questions about AgriNova's marketplace, weather telemetry, accounts, and policies.

items.question: What is AgriNova?
items.answer: AgriNova is a digital agriculture marketplace and decision-support system connecting Indian farmers directly with commercial crop buyers, providing real-time agro-meteorological forecasts and transparent mandi price indicators.

items.question: Who can use AgriNova?
items.answer: AgriNova is built for individual farmers, farmer producer organizations (FPOs), wholesale merchants, food processing plants, modern retailers, and institutional agricultural purchasers across India.

items.question: How do farmers register?
items.answer: Farmers can register by selecting 'Register as Farmer' on our portal, verifying their email address with a 6-digit OTP, providing their farm location (via GPS or city search), and entering their primary crops.

items.question: How do buyers register?
items.answer: Buyers register under 'Register as Buyer' with verified email OTP, business details (wholesaler, processor, retailer, exporter), operating city, and valid 15-character GSTIN number.

items.question: Is email verification required?
items.answer: Yes. To protect farmers and merchants from fraudulent accounts, all users must complete a 6-digit email OTP verification before creating their AgriNova account.

items.question: How can I sell crops?
items.answer: Once registered, farmers can list their harvest lot specifying crop variety, quantity in quintals or tonnes, expected price, quality grade, harvest readiness date, and farm pickup location.

items.question: How do buyers find crops?
items.answer: Buyers browse the AgriNova Marketplace and filter by crop category, lot volume, location/state, price range, and verified farmer badges to find exactly what they need.

items.question: Does AgriNova purchase crops itself?
items.answer: No. AgriNova is an open platform and direct digital bridge. We do not purchase or warehouse crops ourselves; we enable farmers and buyers to transact directly without intermediaries.

items.question: Who decides the crop price?
items.answer: Farmers set their own expected lot prices, and buyers can negotiate terms directly. AgriNova provides regional APMC mandi price benchmarks as reference data to support fair market outcomes.

items.question: How does AgriNova reduce dependence on middlemen?
items.answer: By providing direct farmer-to-buyer communication, transparent benchmark prices, and verified identities, farmers can sell outside restrictive commission agent cartels and retain higher margins.

items.question: How does weather information work?
items.answer: We fetch live agro-meteorological satellite telemetry via Open-Meteo based on your approximate GPS coordinates or selected district, offering 5-day forecasts, rain probability, wind speeds, and agricultural weather advisories.

items.question: Does AgriNova track my location?
items.answer: No. AgriNova only requests browser GPS coordinates upon your explicit permission to fetch localized weather or pin your farm location. We do not engage in background continuous location tracking.

items.question: Can I use AgriNova in Gujarati?
items.answer: Yes! AgriNova provides full native support for English, Hindi (हिन्दी), and Gujarati (ગુજરાતી). You can toggle languages at any time from the navigation bar.

items.question: How do I reset my password?
items.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login screen, enter your registered email address, and follow the password reset link sent to your inbox.

items.question: How can I contact support?
items.answer: You can reach our help desk via the Contact Page (/contact), through our support categories (/support), or by emailing darshakjikadra4@gmail.com.

items.question: Is my information secure?
items.answer: Yes. AgriNova uses industry-standard encryption, SHA-256 OTP hashing, PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS), and zero frontend exposure of sensitive server credentials.

cta.title: Still have questions?
cta.subtitle: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Reach out directly to our customer support team.
